criteria.name: visual_specificity
criteria.description: Each setting description gives a concrete visual — named colors, specific objects, light quality, spatial feel. Not generic genre backdrops.

criteria.name: atmosphere
criteria.description: The description conveys mood through sensory detail — what it smells like, the ambient sound, the emotional register. Reader should feel the space.

criteria.name: image_gen_utility
criteria.description: The description would produce a usable background if fed to an image generator — it specifies style, composition cues, and enough detail without being contradictory.

criteria.name: story_fit
criteria.description: The settings feel like they belong to the same world and tone as the story. IDs and names are appropriate and consistent.
